title: Reception of the RRCRelease by the UE

entities.name: RRCRelease
entities.description: RRC message that releases the RRC connection and moves the UE to RRC_IDLE state.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives and processes the RRCRelease message.

entities.name: Actions specified in clause 5.3.8
entities.description: The set of actions that the UE must perform upon receiving RRCRelease, as defined in clause 5.3.8 of TS 38.331.

relations.description: The UE performs actions upon reception of the RRCRelease message.
The UE shall perform the actions specified in clause 5.3.8.
